sloka: ऋषभं च सुविक्रान्तं जाम्बवन्तं महाबलम् ।ये चेमे सुमहात्मानो मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः ।। ७.४०.६ ॥
transliteration: ṛṣabhaṁ ca suvikrāntaṁ jāmbavantaṁ mahābalam ।ye ceme sumahātmāno madarthe tyaktajīvitāḥ ।। 7.40.6 ॥

translations.english: Also see Rishabha, the very valorous, and Jambavan of great strength, and all these other great-souled beings who risked their lives for my sake.
translations.hindi: राजा ने जब तपस्वी पुलस्त्य जी का नाम अथवा आगमन सुना, तब वे हाथ जोड़े हुए उनकी अगवानी को गए
